questionText: [Set 49.26] The landmark silent film 'Raja Harishchandra', recognized as the first full-length indigenous Indian feature film, was directed and produced in 1913 by:

Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Mass_Media (Cinema History - First Indian Indigenous Feature Film: Raja Harishchandra):
Dadasaheb Phalke is celebrated as the Father of Indian Cinema. He wrote, directed, and produced 'Raja Harishchandra' (released on 3 May 1913 at Coronation Cinematograph in Bombay), founding the Indian film industry.
